articles.title: How the streets and a social media army led Lula to a historic win in Brazil
articles.description: After ending the first round 2.2 million votes behind his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula won the election with a difference of 4 million votes, and will serve a fourth term as president
articles.titleJa: 街頭とソーシャルメディア軍がルーラをブラジルの歴史的勝利に導いた経緯
articles.summary: ルーラはブラジル大統領選でボルソナール氏に400万票差で勝利し、4期目の大統領に就任。街頭とSNSの力が勝因。

articles.title: Warning Signals: Venezuela and the Risk of AI-Powered Chinese Digital Authoritarianism
articles.description: A report by the Australian think tank ASPI warns that Venezuela could integrate Chinese artificial intelligence into its surveillance system and expand its digital control capabilities.
articles.titleJa: 警告信号：ベネズエラとAI駆動型中国デジタル権威主義のリスク
articles.summary: ASPIの報告書は、ベネズエラが中国のAIを監視システムに統合し、デジタル管理能力を拡大するリスクを警告。

articles.title: Queer mediums of the cult of María Lionza are redefining the gender binary in Venezuela’s sacred mountain
articles.description: An ethnographic look at Venezuela's María Lionza cult, examining how LGBTQ+ mediums challenge traditional gender roles and face discrimination while channeling diverse spiritual entities
articles.titleJa: マリア・リオンサ信仰のクィアな媒体がベネズエラの聖なる山でジェンダーバイナリを再定義
articles.summary: ベネズエラのマリア・リオンサ信仰におけるLGBTQ+の媒体が、伝統的なジェンダー役割に挑戦し、差別と向き合いながら様々な霊的存在をチャネリングする。

articles.title: Ex-media executive admits saying Australian child sex abuse survivor 'looking to be raped again'
articles.description: The former Murdoch media executive was overheard at an event referring to the way Grace Tame was dressed.
articles.titleJa: 元メディア幹部、オーストラリア児童性的虐待生存者に対し「再びレイプされたがっている」と発言したことを認める
articles.summary: 元マードック系メディア幹部が、グレース・テイム氏の服装について不適切な発言をしたことを認めた。

articles.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
articles.description: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.
articles.titleJa: ニュージーランドの連立与党、議会過半数に1議席足りず
articles.summary: 国民党率いる右派連立与党は、政権樹立に必要な過半数に届かなかった。

articles.title: Asia made a big AI bet on Nvidia. What happens now?
articles.description: Asian stocks have been on a rollercoaster ride after Jensen Huang's shock return as Nvidia CEO.

articles.title: My dad's watch stopped the moment he died - I found it in the ashes of Hong Kong tower fire
articles.description: The city marks a year since a huge blaze tore through seven apartment blocks, killing 168 people.
articles.titleJa: 父の時計は彼が亡くなった瞬間に止まった – 香港のタワー火災の灰の中でそれを見つけた
articles.summary: 香港で7つのアパートが焼失し168人が死亡した大規模火災から1年が経過した。

articles.title: A renovation was meant to improve these Hong Kong homes - it ended in a blaze that killed 168
articles.description: A year after one of Hong Kong's deadliest fires, families left behind are still waiting for justice.
articles.titleJa: 香港の住宅改修は改善のはずだったが、168人が死亡する火災で終わった
articles.summary: 香港史上最悪の火災から1年、遺族は今も正義を求めて待っている。

articles.title: Nine injured, three critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion
articles.description: Black smoke could be seen across Bangkok's skyline after the blast, as officials urged residents to leave the area.
articles.titleJa: バンコクの製油所爆発で9人負傷、うち3人が重体
articles.summary: 爆発後、バンコクの空には黒煙が広がり、当局は住民に避難を促した。

articles.title: Thirteen dead as mine disaster highlights illegal hunt for gold
articles.description: Indonesian authorities say another 13 are missing in the illegal gold mine, which flooded on Monday.
articles.titleJa: 鉱山災害で13人死亡、違法な金採掘が浮き彫りに
articles.summary: インドネシア当局によると、月曜日に浸水した違法金鉱山でさらに13人が行方不明となっている。

articles.title: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
articles.description: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.
articles.titleJa: 米国、中国を含む多くの国に新たな関税を発表
articles.summary: この新たな課徴金は、中国やEUを含む米国の主要な貿易相手国の多くに影響を与えるだろう。

articles.title: Two screenings of Pakistani TV show cancelled in India after backlash
articles.description: The show, Dar-e-Nijaat, has become a sensation in India but is now embroiled in a political row.
articles.titleJa: パキスタンのテレビ番組、反発を受けインドで2回の上映が中止に
articles.summary: 「Dar-e-Nijaat」はインドで人気を博したが、政治的対立に巻き込まれた。

articles.title: North Korea expels Swiss diplomat in sanctions row
articles.description: Swiss officials said relations would be kept through North Korea's embassy in Bern, and its own embassy in Beijing.
articles.titleJa: 北朝鮮、制裁問題でスイス外交官を追放
articles.summary: スイス当局は、関係はベルンの北朝鮮大使館と北京のスイス大使館を通じて維持されると述べた。

articles.title: Services domestic regulation disciplines enter into force for Kazakhstan
articles.description: On 25 November, Kazakhstan notified WTO members that, following conclusion of its domestic approval procedures, the disciplines on services domestic regulation had taken legal effect and had been incorporated into Kazakhstan's schedule under the General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS) as of 27 October 2026. These disciplines, which entered into force at the 13th WTO Ministerial Conference (MC13) in February 2024, have the potential to reduce global trade costs by USD 127 billion.
articles.titleJa: カザフスタン、サービス国内規制規律が発効
articles.summary: カザフスタンは、サービス国内規制規律が法的効力を持ち、2026年10月27日よりGATSに組み込まれたとWTOに通報。これにより、世界の貿易コストが大幅に削減される可能性がある。

articles.title: Brazil requests dispute panel regarding additional duties imposed by the United States
articles.description: At a meeting of the Dispute Settlement Body (DSB) on 24 November, members considered a request from Brazil for the establishment of a dispute panel to review additional US duties on products originating in Brazil as a result of two investigations by the United States under Section 301 of the US Trade Act of 1974.
articles.titleJa: ブラジル、米国が課した追加関税について紛争パネルを要請
articles.summary: ブラジルは、米国がセクション301に基づきブラジル製品に課した追加関税について、紛争解決機関にパネル設置を要請。貿易摩擦が顕在化している。

articles.title: Members briefed on food export restrictions history, safeguard mechanism
articles.description: The history of negotiations on export restrictions on food and a proposed special safeguard mechanism (SSM) for developing economies were the focus of meetings of the Committee on Agriculture's negotiations body on 23 November. This was the latest in a series of thematic briefings by the WTO Secretariat, as members explore options for a path forward in the stalled negotiations on agricultural trade.

articles.title: Trade-facilitating measures help offset rise in new G20 trade restrictions
articles.description: The number of tariff increases and other non-facilitating trade measures introduced by G20 economies rose sharply in the first half of 2026, and the stockpile of such measures reached a record level, according to the WTO's latest report on G20 trade measures. At the same time, G20 economies, representing around 80-85 per cent of global GDP and 75 per cent of international trade, introduced a significant number of trade-facilitating measures, helping to reinforce global trade flows despite heightened geopolitical tensions and economic uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: 貿易円滑化措置がG20の新規貿易制限の増加を相殺するのに寄与
articles.summary: G20諸国による関税引き上げなどの貿易制限措置が増加するも、貿易円滑化措置が導入され、地政学的緊張下でも世界の貿易フローを支えているとWTOが報告。

articles.title: EU launches safeguard investigation into certain composite input materials
articles.description: On 23 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (23 November 2026), a safeguard investigation into imports of certain composite input materials.
articles.titleJa: EU、特定の複合中間材料に対するセーフガード調査を開始
articles.summary: 欧州連合は2026年11月23日、特定の複合中間材料の輸入に対しセーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知。自国産業保護の動きが見られる。

articles.title: Agriculture group meeting weighs trends in global food market trade
articles.description: Current conditions in global agricultural commodities were the focus of a meeting of the Agricultural Market Information System (AMIS) Global Food Market Information Group, held at WTO headquarters in Geneva on 23-24 November. The AMIS, launched by the G20 group of major economies in 2011, seeks to improve market transparency and strengthen food security by bringing together the principal economies involved in agricultural commodities trade and helping to coordinate policy action in times of market uncertainty.
articles.titleJa: 農業グループ会議で世界の食料市場貿易の動向を検討
articles.summary: WTO本部で農業市場情報システム(AMIS)会議が開催され、世界の農業一次産品市場の現状が議論された。食料安全保障と市場透明性の向上が目的。

articles.title: Members review customs valuation notifications, launch new work on preshipment inspection
articles.description: WTO members reviewed compliance with notification obligations under the Customs Valuation Agreement at a meeting on 20 November, at which the Chair highlighted progress in new submissions, while noting persistent gaps. Members also agreed on further work related to preshipment inspection, including updating notifications, examining links with other WTO agreements, and launching the Seventh Triennial Review of the Preshipment Inspection Agreement.
articles.titleJa: 加盟国が税関評価通報をレビュー、船積前検査に関する新たな作業を開始
articles.summary: WTO加盟国は税関評価協定に基づく通報義務の順守状況をレビューし、船積前検査に関する新たな作業（通報更新、他協定との関連検討など）を開始することで合意した。

articles.title: Panama submits request to join Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement
articles.description: Panama has submitted a request to join the 2015 Expansion of the Information Technology Agreement (ITA II), the Chair of the Committee of Participants on the Expansion of Trade in Information Technology Products, Mr Shih-Chun Weng of Chinese Taipei, informed members at a meeting on 19 November. Panama said joining ITA II will help it to advance its goal of a more knowledge-based, innovation-driven and technologically advanced economy.
articles.titleJa: パナマが情報技術協定拡大への参加を要請
articles.summary: パナマは、知識ベースで革新的な経済への移行を目指し、情報技術協定拡大（ITA II）への参加をWTOに要請した。

articles.title: Applications open for WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues
articles.description: The Secretariat of the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) and the Secretariat of the World Trade Organization (WTO) are now accepting applications for the WIPO-WTO Executive Programme on Intellectual Property Issues for Senior Government Officials. The activity will take place from 1 to 12 February 2027 at the headquarters of the WIPO and of the WTO in Geneva, Switzerland.
articles.titleJa: WIPO-WTO知的財産問題幹部研修プログラムの応募開始
articles.summary: WIPOとWTOが2027年2月1日から12日までジュネーブで開催される、知的財産問題に関する政府高官向け研修プログラムの応募受付を開始した。

articles.title: Spotlight on trade fundamentals at annual WTO student event
articles.description: Over 200 students joined policymakers, executives and thought leaders on 18 November at the WTO to discuss trade fundamentals at the WTO's annual student-only event on trade, titled WTO 101: Trade Rules!. Now in its third year, the event saw spirited discussions on the key issues facing the multilateral system and its implications for the next generation.
articles.titleJa: 年次WTO学生イベントで貿易の基本に焦点
articles.summary: 200人以上の学生がWTO年次イベント「WTO 101: 貿易ルール！」に参加し、多角的貿易システムが次世代に与える影響や主要課題について活発な議論が交わされた。
